fullPassage: As the set of cultural norms and categories taken for granted at any particular time, the present is normally more or less invisible to those who participate in it. It is the unthought background of their thought and action, like water to a fish, or air to a dove. In films, this background can sometimes become visible as a bygone present in a film that is not just historically but culturally dated. In the culturally dated film, attitudes and ways of behaving that have altered over time and which now appear as quaint, strange, 'incorrect' or problematic, are taken for granted by the characters in the film, and go unquestioned or are even happily endorsed in the film's narrative. The present is also visible in contemporary historical dramas that 'read the past in terms of the present', anachronistically importing modern attitudes into the past they portray. This is something that is doubly evident in dated historical films that read the past in terms of their present, where the anachronisms are themselves reflective of a bygone present.

det.korean: 다른 시대에 속하는 것으로 연대적 불일치를 초래하는 것 = anachronism(시대착오)
det.analysis:
✅ ① anachronism: '시대착오'는 다른 시대의 것이 섞여 연대적 불일치를 만든다는 정의와 일치 ← 정답
❌ ② narrative: '서사'는 이야기 구조로 시대 불일치와 무관
❌ ③ endorsement: '지지'는 승인을 의미
❌ ④ category: '범주'는 분류를 의미
det.tip: anachronism = 시대착오. chronological inconsistency = 연대적 불일치

questions.passage: In films, this background can sometimes become __________ (visibility) as a bygone present in a film that is not just historically but culturally dated.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: become 뒤에 보어로 형용사가 필요. 명사 visibility를 형용사 visible로 변환. 'become visible'(가시적으로 되다).
det.tip: become + 형용사 보어: become visible = 보이게 되다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 동사구 importing을 수식하는 부사가 필요. 명사 anachronism을 부사 anachronistically로 변환. 'anachronistically importing'(시대착오적으로 도입하며).

overlay.excerptSentences: The present is also visible in contemporary historical dramas that 'read the past in terms of the present', __________ (anachronism) importing modern attitudes into the past they portray.

questions.passage: As the set of cultural norms and categories taken for granted at any particular time, the present is normally more or less invisible to those who participate in it. It is __________, like water to a fish, or air to a dove. In films, this background can sometimes become visible as a bygone present in a film that is not just historically but culturally dated. In the culturally dated film, attitudes and ways of behaving that have altered over time and which now appear as quaint, strange, 'incorrect' or problematic, are taken for granted by the characters in the film, and go unquestioned or are even happily endorsed in the film's narrative. The present is also visible in contemporary historical dramas that 'read the past in terms of the present', anachronistically importing modern attitudes into the past they portray. This is something that is doubly evident in dated historical films that read the past in terms of their present, where the anachronisms are themselves reflective of a bygone present.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① a deliberate choice made by individuals: '의도적 선택'은 무의식적 배경이라는 맥락과 반대
✅ ② the unthought background of their thought and action: '그들의 생각과 행동의 무의식적 배경'은 물고기에게 물처럼 의식하지 못하는 것이라는 원문과 일치 ← 정답
❌ ③ a well-documented record of past events: '잘 기록된 과거 사건'은 비가시적 배경과 불일치
❌ ④ a subject of constant debate among scholars: '학자들의 끊임없는 논쟁 대상'은 본문에 언급 없음
det.tip: unthought background = 무의식적 배경. 물고기에게 물, 비둘기에게 공기

det.korean: 낡은 역사 영화에서 ____하는 곳에서 이중으로 명백하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① accurately recreate the customs of the past: '과거 관습을 정확히 재현한다'는 시대착오적 도입과 모순
❌ ② intentionally avoid modern perspectives: '의도적으로 현대 관점을 피한다'는 무의식적 시대착오와 반대
✅ ③ read the past in terms of their present: '자신들의 현재로 과거를 읽는다'는 시대착오가 과거 현재를 반영한다는 원문과 일치 ← 정답
❌ ④ present a neutral view of historical events: '역사적 사건의 중립적 관점을 제시한다'는 시대착오적 편향과 불일치
det.tip: read the past in terms of their present = 자신들의 현재로 과거를 해석하다
